doc: Per-hunter run speed and acceleration [game data]: SUPERVIVE's CT_LokiCharacterAttributes (MoveSpeed uu/s, MaxAcceleration uu/s^2), divided by 100 for metres. Ids are our archetypes: bulwark = Oath, dredge = Kingpin, thief = Shiv, mage = Joule, dolm = Tetra, ostra = Void, ashwick = Felix, juggernaut = Brall, archer = Myth, tender = Elluna, gunslinger = Ghost, rimewright = Celeste. climb_tall: the hunter can mantle double-high ledges (bCanWallJump: Myth and Brall only). A hunter not listed uses its class speed and the default accel.

physics.doc: Ground stop, dash exit, air, fall, glide, dive and mantle tunables shared by every hunter [game data]: BP_LokiHeroCharacter's movement component and the world settings, uu divided by 100 for metres. brake: BrakingDecelerationWalking (m/s^2), the constant part of the walking stop. ground_friction: GroundFriction 1.0 x UE's BrakingFrictionFactor 2 (1/s), the share of the speed a let-go sheds per second; together a let-go from a run stops in ~0.17 s and ~0.3 m. dash_exit_run: a dash ends at this share of run speed (never faster than the dash), so it carries into the walk, brake or jump instead of stopping dead; the data has no hard stop, and the dash curves that set the exact exit are not decoded. Air control is not here: the owner overruled SUPERVIVE's low AirControl (11-08), see content/rules/tuning.json air. fall_cap: AbyssFallSlowSpeedLimitMin (m/s), the fastest fall, easing to abyss_fall_cap between abyss_slow_from and abyss_slow_to metres under an island's lip over the abyss (AbyssFallSlowDistMin/Max). glide_height: GlideDownwardForceHeightTarget, above which the glider pulls you down at up to glide_pull_vy (GlideDownwardForceMinZVelocity); the drop never turns into speed (owner 11-08). glide_accel: GlideTargetXYForce 162,500 over the hunter's Mass 100 (m/s^2), the glider's pull toward where you steer at or under cruise, so a turn or a reversal has inertia (a reversal at cruise ~0.6 s). glide_start_vy: GlideStartFallSpeedMin (m/s), the slowest the glider falls the step it opens: a rising jump is cut to this fall, the open never adds speed (the matching Max, the fastest fall an open leaves you with, is locked: the canopy catch rate is ours, tuning.json glide.catch). turn_rate: RotationRate yaw (deg/s), how fast the body turns to the cursor: a fixed rate, so a small aim change lands at once and a 180 takes 0.14 s. mantle_vy_cap / mantle_pull: MantleSuctionUpwardsForceZSpeedCap (m/s) and MantleSuctionUpwardsForceMax over Mass 100 (m/s^2): within Hunter.MANTLE_REACH (MantleSuctionUpwardsForceHeightMax 1.5 m) under a lip the suction pulls you up only while you rise slower than the cap, so a jump's own momentum carries you over [?: the distance curve that scales the pull is not decoded; the max is used throughout]. mantle_launch_keep / mantle_launch_min: MiniMantleXYSpeedTargetCoefficient / Min, the speed onto a ledge you climb (share of run speed, at least this many m/s). dive_vy / dive_accel: GlideDiveZTargetSpeed (m/s) and GlideDiveZForceMax over the hunter's Mass (m/s^2), the glider's plunge while crouch is held under it; dive_steer: GlideDiveXYForceMultiplier, the share of the glide's steering force the keys keep in the plunge; dive_cancel_h: GlideDiveCancelDistance (m) above the ground where the plunge ends and the glide catches you; dive_timeout: GlideDiveTimeout (s) of holding before it ends on its own.
